profile.headline: #GHC25 | Frontend Software Engineer, Growth
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
Creative edge and a track record of delivering scalable, user-focused solutions at enterprise scale.
I thrive at the intersection of design and engineering breaking down complex problems into clean, intuitive, and performant systems that serve both the business and the end user.

I’m especially interested in teams that value design, user experience, accessibility, and engineering culture—where thoughtful collaboration leads to products people love to use.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Adapted quickly across the Entertainment, Benefits, and Rewards Membership teams within the Loyalty organization, leveraging diverse engineering approaches to deliver impactful solutions.

• Redesigned the Rewards landing page reaching reaching 100k+ daily users with micro front end architecture, improving load times by 22%. Utilized performance tools such as React Profiler, Lighthouse, Dynatrace, and Grafana to optimize scalability and responsiveness, helping achieve a top J.D. Power ranking for digital experience.

• Architected and led the implementation of the rewards highlights component on American Express’s global rewards platform, providing users with an overview of their points and spending history. This led to a 4% increase in redemptions and a 12% boost in offer engagement, directly supporting key business objectives.

• Improved accessibility by providing appropriate landmarks and ARIA roles, enhancing link semantics, and enhanced image alt text where needed. Conducted comprehensive screen reader testing and leveraged Axe DevTools to identify and resolve issues, resulting in a 98% Lighthouse accessibility score for the Rewards page.

• Rolled out the rewards redemption page to co-brand users (Hilton, Marriott, Delta) for the first time. Designed and implemented a dynamic loading solution with responsive layouts and breakpoint-aware CSS—boosting UI modularity, performance, and driving an 18% increase in user interactions.

• Automated versioning & dependency management with Internal CLI, streamlining workflows and reducing manual overhead.

• Conducted A/B testing on reward redemption UI components to identify the most effective design.

• Used Adobe Analytics to drive data-informed decisions that improved user engagement and the overall redemption experience.

• Led cross-functional collaboration with design, back-end, and QA teams, establishing API contracts to streamline integration, reduce dependencies, and enhance delivery efficiency.

positions.title: CAD Designer
positions.description:
Created graphics and color assets, streamlined workflows, and supported seasonal palette development.

• Collaborated with Adobe developers to design and implement a UI for the color program in Adobe Experience Manager.

• Built onboarding curriculum for 60+ cross-functional team members, reducing ramp-up time by 50%.

• Partnered with Lbrands colorists to define seasonal palettes and produced 1,000+ digital assets, achieving 99%+ fabric-match accuracy.

positions.title: Textile Artist for Dana Buchman
positions.description:
• Created production-ready prints, patterns, and color stories using Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop

• Developed seasonal mood boards and design presentations aligned with brand strategy and trend research

• Collaborated with cross-functional teams including design, merchandising, and production to execute product vision

• Maintained accurate product data and tech packs in the Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) system

• Supported design reviews with original artwork, color direction, and detailed trim sheets

positions.title: Cad Designer
positions.description:
• Designed all-over prints, screen prints, embroideries, and yarn-dye patterns for juniors’ and girls’ apparel across tops, dresses, bottoms, and outerwear

• Created seamless print repeats, recolored artwork for seasonal palettes, and prepped production-ready files to meet factory specs

• Cleaned and modified purchased artwork to align with brand aesthetics and market needs

• Conducted trend research in print, textile, and fashion to inform commercially viable design direction

• Collaborated with design and sales teams to ensure timely delivery and cohesive product alignment

• Executed designs using Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator with a strong focus on color, detail, and print placement
